title: Cross-Domain Recovery Lag Finder
dataSources: Daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`), personal SLO status (`personalslo:status`), cross-signal correlations (`correlation:pair`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The meta layer — correlating every `index=personal` feed (sleep, activity, mood, weather, spend, productivity, home telemetry) into daily life scores, personal SLOs, and cross-signal anomaly detection, all computed in Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=correlation:pair
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag, avg(correlation) as avg_correlation, count as observations by left_signal right_signal
| sort - avg_lag
description: Shows which improvements tend to take the longest to show up somewhere else in your life data.
value: Not every good habit pays off immediately, and a lag view helps you stay patient with the right ones.
implementation: Publish lag-aware correlation summaries to `index=personal`; review average lag and correlation by signal pair.
visualization: Signal-pair table of average lag days and average correlation.
grandmaExplanation: It warns which good signals take the longest to ripple into other parts of your life, helping you stay patient with the right habits.
